faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Hillsborough?
faq.answer: Hillsborough homeowners typically invest $20,000 to $60,000+ for window replacement projects. This ultra-exclusive Peninsula enclave — the wealthiest municipality per capita in California — features estate homes with 20–40+ windows, often requiring custom sizing, premium hardware, and specialty glass. Projects using Marvin Ultimate or Andersen A-Series can exceed $80,000 for larger estates.

faq.question: Do I need a permit for window replacement in Hillsborough?
faq.answer: Yes. Hillsborough requires building permits for all window replacements. The Town of Hillsborough's Building Department is known for thorough review; all projects require professionally prepared permit documents. Our team manages all permit applications, architectural drawings coordination, and inspection scheduling on your behalf.

faq.question: Which window brands does Deluxe Windows install in Hillsborough?
faq.answer: Hillsborough's uncompromising estate market exclusively demands the highest-tier products. We most frequently specify Marvin Ultimate wood-clad fiberglass for its limitless customization and finest finishes, Andersen A-Series for traditional estate homes with authentic wood interiors, and Western Window Systems for indoor-outdoor living wall installations.

faq.question: Does Deluxe Windows serve all Hillsborough neighborhoods?
faq.answer: Yes — we serve the entire Town of Hillsborough including all residential areas in the upper and lower zones, Crystal Springs Road corridor, and all of zip code 94010.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Hillsborough?
faq.answer: Most Hillsborough projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once windows arrive, typically four to eight weeks after ordering.
